notes: FocusMode reports read_only while the body is in MF; the switch is physical.
FocusArea differs between AF-S (1) and AF-C (17).
FocusPositionSetting 0x020E stayed read_write in AF-S and AF-C.

capability_notes.content_index: Available only in RemoteTransfer, together with thumbnail and screennail.
capability_notes.live_view: Available only in Remote. RemoteTransfer returned a generic error from the image call and a zero-byte buffer from the info call.
capability_notes.postview_configuration: Refused in Remote with vendor status 0x8402 and accepted in RemoteTransfer. Configuration acceptance and delivery are independent: Remote refused configuration and still delivered a postview when the destination included the host.

content.ids_note: Monotonically increasing but not guaranteed contiguous; a gap of one was observed. New content must be detected with id > baseline, never baseline + 1.

focus.note: Absolute focus positioning was exercised; the commanded position was reached exactly on every move measured.

identity_strings.note: These properties report zero through the numeric accessor and carry their value through the string accessor.

property_surface.count_is_not_a_health_check: The same body reported 394 in Remote and 392 in RemoteTransfer. A count is an observation.
property_surface.remote_only_codes_note: Absent from the vendor property enumeration this release resolved names from, read-only, and present only where live view is. No name is asserted for either.

transfer.host_delivery_in_remote: With the destination including the host, the host received a downscaled JPEG at the screennail geometry, not the captured original.
transfer.original_transfer_note: A full-size RAW was written and its byte count matched the size the content index reported. Identifiers are plain integers; no vendor content handle is involved.
transfer.still_image_trans_size_note: SmallSize. Original is the other documented value; requesting it and repeating the capture is untested.
transfer.wrong_mode_rejected: The ContentsTransfer control mode returned a vendor status in the 0x8402 family for the same call.
